name: AutoZone, Inc.
summary: AutoZone, Inc. operates as a retailer and distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories in the Americas. The company offers a product line for cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light duty trucks, including new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, maintenance items, accessories, and non-automotive products. It also provides failure products, such as A/C compressors, batteri
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 64/100 (Interessant), Innovations-Score 25/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 4455.40 USD (+33 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
